metaDescription: Mercantile is a Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod that overhauls villagers and trading: pickup, names, reputation, trade cycling, and the Sentry Pylon defense block.
ogDescription: Mercantile is a Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod that overhauls villagers and trading: pickup, names, reputation, trade cycling, and the Sentry Pylon defense block.

hero.lede: A villager and trade overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).
hero.sub: Pickup, names, reputation, trade cycling, sentry pylons, and more.

sections.title: Features
sections.lede: A glimpse of what Mercantile changes. Full list →

items.title: Villager Pickup
html: Sneak-right-click a villager to pick it up. Full NBT — profession, trades, gossip — is preserved.

items.title: Villager Names
html: Biome-themed names are auto-assigned on spawn and always visible above the villager.

items.title: Trade Cycling
html: Refresh a villager's trade pool using emeralds and emerald blocks instead of breaking their workstation.

items.title: Reputation
html: A five-tier global standing with persistent gossip that travels with villagers across the world.

items.title: Sentry Pylon
html: An iron-fueled defense block that spawns temporary iron golems to guard your village.

items.title: …and many more.
html: See all features →
